rationale: Inspection of the attached source pages supports agreement on scalar real transport, constant signed velocity, hyperbolicity, characteristic translation, flux orientation, and the absence of a uniqueness claim. The translation is nonvacuous and preserves the principal mathematical structure. Acceptance remains unresolved because the source leaves profile admissibility and nonsmooth integral semantics unspecified, while the translation chooses precise analytic branches and records an external semantic boundary. Adjudication is required; no definite counterexample to the translation's mathematical claims is asserted.
